item.title: App Development: Two Products Built from Zero to App Store
item.description: Managed the full product lifecycle for two iOS apps — from ideation and product strategy to development, App Store launch, and go-to-market. Both live. Both serving real users in the NYC construction industry.

item.title: B2B SaaS: 47% Lower CPL, 86% More MQLs on Google Ads
item.description: Removed 340 keywords bleeding $6k/month in wasted spend, rebuilt campaign structure from scratch, and fixed conversion tracking that was double-counting 40% of leads. Pipeline value 3.8× in one quarter.

item.title: Commercial Insurance: 239% More Leads, Same Budget
item.description: Flipped the channel mix after the audit showed Meta CPL was 60% lower than Google. Rebuilt landing pages, cut form fields from 9 to 4, and built a 3-stage retargeting sequence. 18 leads/month became 61. Budget didn’t change.

item.title: D2C Apparel: 50% ROAS Lift on $100k Meta Spend
